com.empline/tool-documentation.access: Requires OAuth store:prices:write consent. Write consent is required because this preparation issues price-update approvals. The connected account must own an approved store.
com.empline/tool-documentation.effects: Read-only; issuing approvals does not apply prices or enable automation.
com.empline/tool-documentation.failures: Unknown/unowned or unavailable custom listings and mixed input modes are refused. Holds, sale prices and seller price bounds prevent custom approvals; strategy proposals also require usable market guidance.
com.empline/tool-documentation.notFor: Recurring pricing, inventory quantities and listing publication are outside this proposal.
com.empline/tool-documentation.purpose: Prepare exact one-time card price changes for explicit user confirmation.
com.empline/tool-documentation.returns: Returns old/proposed prices, market guidance with timestamp/usability, cached lowest catalog asking price when available, skipped reasons and signed approvals valid ten minutes. Cached catalog asks are not live or grade-matched sold comps.
com.empline/tool-documentation.useWhen: Use when the user wants an in-chat price update. Supply updates with owned listingId and exact USD price pairs, or a strategy selection; never combine them. Omitted strategy uses the store setting.

cardType.description: Review RAW, graded/authenticated, or all active in-stock card copies in the connected store.

cursor.description: Continue with nextCursor from the previous page, keeping the same selection.

direction.description: Filter one-time price changes. Ongoing repricing requires ANY; publishing includes all displayed cards.

strategy.description: AT_MARKET, PREMIUM (above market), or MOVE_FAST. Omit to use the existing store strategy. Confirmed automation uses this as store-wide strategy.

updates.description: Exact custom prices in USD for owned listing IDs from list_store_listings. Use alone; do not combine with strategy, cardType, direction or cursor. Duplicate IDs are rejected. Show the prepared old/new prices and ask for confirmation before applying.

listingId.description: Owned listing ID, not a catalog ID or slug.

price.description: Exact listing price in USD, with at most two decimal places.
